historyCoverage: Complete Basketball Champions League (BCL) Final Four archive (2017–2024), tracking champions, runners-up, scores, venues, and Final Four MVPs.

records.margin: Belgrade Arena (Belgrade, Serbia); Kendrick Perry named Final Four MVP with 17 points
Palacio de Deportes José María Martín Carpena (Málaga); TJ Shorts scored 29 points for Final Four MVP
Bilbao Arena (Bilbao, Spain); Marcelinho Huertas recorded 13 points and 14 assists for Final Four MVP; second title for Tenerife
Trade Union Sport Palace (Nizhny Novgorod, Russia); Vítor Benite named Final Four MVP; Burgos defended title
O.A.C.A. Olympic Indoor Hall (Athens); Thaddus McFadden scored 18 points for Final Four MVP; first title for Burgos
Sportpaleis (Antwerp, Belgium); Kevin Punter scored 26 points for Final Four MVP
O.A.C.A. Olympic Indoor Hall (Athens); Mike Green named Final Four MVP before 18,000 roaring home fans
Pabellón Insular Santiago Martín (San Cristóbal de La Laguna); Marius Grigonis named Final Four MVP in inaugural BCL season
